surfaces.name: Tempest desktop app (Tauri 2; Windows, macOS, Linux)
Tempest Mobile companion (Expo; Android APK in releases, iOS from source)

claims.answer: Tauri desktop app for Windows, macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel) and Linux with installers and an auto-update manifest; an Android companion APK attached to releases; iOS only via source build; no browser client.

scope.plan: Open source (Apache-2.0; mobile app MIT), free, local-first

desktop_os.answer: v0.1.25 assets include dmg, msi, setup exe, AppImage and deb for Windows, macOS and Linux.

mobile_apps.answer: Android APK is attached to releases; the iOS app builds only with the developer's own Apple account.

browser.answer: The product is a desktop app; the repository web/ directory is the marketing site.

cli.answer: The tempest-cli repository only downloads the app via npm; no product CLI beyond launching.

editor_extensions.answer: No editor extension; an Open in IDE button exists.

task_actions.answer: Start sessions, type into the terminal, interrupt and stop, review diffs, stage, commit, push and open a PR; mobile can send prompts and interrupt.

notifications.answer: In-app Task complete notifications and badges; native OS notifications are listed as in progress and mobile has no push.

cross_device_continuity.answer: The phone streams the same sessions from the desktop over LAN or tunnel; desktop must stay on.

limitations: Mobile uses LAN pairing by default and has no push notifications; iOS is not distributed; no browser UI or CLI product.

claims.answer: Manifest-driven agent registry covering Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, Antigravity, OpenCode, Copilot CLI, Cline, Cursor Agent, Goose, Qwen Code, Droid, Amp, Hermes, Pi and Grok, run in PTYs, plus headless chat nodes with BYOK API providers.

evidence.title: README.md
evidence.locator: Intro; One window; Process-isolated; Build from source; License
evidence.finding: Tauri 2 desktop app running Claude Code, Codex, Gemini and other CLI agents in parallel git worktrees with a shared local code graph (Token Intelligence), live status, history, diff and PR, Hephaestus per-agent process isolation on Windows/macOS/Linux, agents permissionless by default with toggles in Settings > Security; Apache-2.0.

evidence.title: LICENSE
evidence.finding: Apache License, Version 2.0 for the repository; apps/mobile carries an MIT license file.

evidence.title: ROADMAP.md
evidence.locator: Foundation shipped; Now building; On the roadmap; Cloud and team layer
evidence.finding: Shipped: Threads canvas, Token Intelligence, Database Branches, Tempest Bridge; building: Threads polish, Hephaestus hardening, Automations (beta), more agents, desktop notifications; planned: Tasks tab, mobile apps, remote agents, multi-agent coordination, optional hosted team layer with SSO and audit logs.

evidence.title: SECURITY.md
evidence.finding: Vulnerability reporting by email with 3 business day acknowledgement.

evidence.title: docs/architecture.mdx
evidence.finding: Tauri Rust backend manages PTY sessions, git worktrees and an Atlas Node MCP server; React frontend with xterm.js, CodeMirror and diff viewer.

evidence.title: docs/agents/supported.mdx
evidence.locator: Comparison Table; Provider presets; Manifest-Driven Agents
evidence.finding: Agent manifests for Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex CLI, Antigravity, Opencode, Copilot CLI, Cline, Cursor Agent, Goose, Qwen Code, Droid, Amp, Hermes, Pi, fx, Grok with resume and auto-approve flags per agent.

evidence.title: docs/agents/overview.mdx
evidence.locator: What Is an Agent Session; Command Construction
evidence.finding: An agent session is a PTY in a worktree or project root with a conversation ID resumed across restarts.

evidence.title: docs/chat/overview.mdx
evidence.locator: Three backends; Model picker; CLI agent bridges
evidence.finding: Chat nodes run API (BYOK via OS credential manager), CLI agent or Warp backends; CLI bridges use the CLI's own login.

evidence.title: docs/git/push-pr.mdx

evidence.title: docs/automations/overview.mdx

locations.result: Roadmap lists Now building (Threads polish, Hephaestus hardening, Automations beta, more agents, desktop notifications, keyboard) and On the roadmap (Tasks tab, mobile apps, remote agents, multi-agent coordination, cloud and team layer with SSO and audit logs) without dates.

announced.summary: Remote agents and a managed hosted team layer are listed as planned (no date).
